name: Sakaki Eiji
source:
3rd year high school student.
Student Council Vice President
Star Sign: Aquarius
Because of his strength there are rumors around the school that he has "Gone 400 fights without being defeated." and "He can defeat a bear with just his fists.", but he himself is fed up with that kind of talk.
